constraints.description: Students must complete four fixed core courses totaling 16 units.

constraints.source_text: Students must take two courses from Tier 1 and three courses from Tier 2.
constraints.description: Students select two courses from the Tier 1 flexible core list.

constraints.source_text: Students must take two courses from Tier 1 and three courses from Tier 2.

Students select three elective courses from the given list.

constraints.source_text: Students may not complete more than one of the following courses: TAC 115 , TAC 116 , CSCI 103L and CSCI 113x
constraints.description: Only one of TAC 115, TAC 116, CSCI 103L, or CSCI 113x may count toward the degree.

constraints.source_text: A course that is listed in multiple categories can only be applied once.
constraints.description: A course appearing in more than one category may only be counted toward one requirement.

details.scope: core, flexible core, and electives categories

constraints.source_text: Students must choose a minimum of 16 upper-division units from the flexible core and electives lists.
constraints.description: At least 16 units chosen from the flexible core and electives lists must be upper-division.

unclassified.source_text: Note: Students that are interested in focusing on aspects of Cognitive Science that draw from Computer Science will need to take CSCI 103L , and CSCI 104L , in order to take the more advanced Computer Science offerings in the curriculum. In considering how many CSCI courses to take, students should consider that units from these courses are outside of the Dornsife College, and will not be counted toward the required Dornsife College units.
unclassified.why: Advisory guidance about planning CSCI courses, not a binding degree requirement.

unclassified.source_text: The cognitive science major with honors requires the student to complete the requirements for the major with a GPA of 3.5 or above and to complete in addition CGSC 498 Honors Thesis with a grade of B or better. Intent to complete the cognitive science major with honors should be registered with the undergraduate adviser no later than the second semester of the junior year.
unclassified.why: Optional honors track requirement, which is out of scope per taxonomy rules.

unclassified.source_text: Students are encouraged to refer to the suggested tracks below, and to consult with their academic adviser.
unclassified.why: Advisory statement, not a binding requirement.
